question: Which procedure applies for the second site?
expectedAnswerPoints: Asks which site and which project the employee means: the tenant has more than one project with published briefs, and the answer differs by project. Once named, only that project's documents may be used.
forbiddenClaims: Must not answer from a project the requester is not a member of; must not compare two projects' client data in one answer.
expectedSource: none until the site is named; project briefs SYNTH-UAV-SITEBRIEF-02 page:1 section:1 and SYNTH-UAV-NOTE-2026-0007-SYNTH page:1 section:1
